title: Zesty Roasted Slovakian Red Bean Dumplings
description: A roasted, glassy-jelly, indulgent Slovakian dish featuring anko-red-bean-paste, wok-hei, and paleo-friendly ingredients, served in a bento box.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the red bean paste, coconut flour, eggs, coconut oil, salt, and vanilla extract.
Gradually add the water to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Place the balls onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the sesame oil over the dumplings and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
Remove the dumplings from the oven and let them cool for 5 minutes.
Serve the dumplings in a bento box and enjoy.
